analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($49.10) vs SMA5($48.71)/SMA20($57.42)/SMA50($68.36): Attempting to reclaim short-term support, below mid-term MAs.
· Significant distance below SMA100($69.60)/SMA200($65.47): Long-term trend remains weak.
· 52-Week Position(23.2%): Entering a recovery phase from the 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (35.8→38.7): Exiting oversold territory, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.3036→-0.7757): Weakness persists but is improving, post-death cross, in a bearish convergence phase.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid Band $57.42): Below the mid-band, maintaining a 16.2% distance from the lower band($42.08).
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support($48.75): SMA5 support confirmed, recovery from 5-day low($40.12).
· Swing Resistance($51.96): Short-term resistance zone, potential for further gains towards 5-day high($56.19) if broken.
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery start): Signal of slowing downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.05x): Normal level, no significant strength in the move.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): RSI exit from oversold and MACD improvement confirmed, indicating a short-term rebound attempt. Volume at 1.05x the 5-day average supports the move. Price at $49.10, recovering from the 52-week low of $40.12, showing early signs of a Higher Low pattern. Reclaimed swing support at $48.75 and confirmed SMA5 support. Further upside expected if short-term resistance at $51.96 is broken.
